mapper.select: SELECT game_id, skill_key, effect_key, name, description, sort_order, jsonb_array_length(results) AS result_count, lifecycle IS NOT NULL AS lifecycle_enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM public.skill_effects WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, effect_key ASC

SELECT game_id, skill_key, effect_key, name, description, sort_order, results::text AS results, lifecycle::text AS lifecycle, created_at, updated_at FROM public.skill_effects WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND effect_key = #{effectKey}

SELECT game_id, skill_key, effect_key, name, description, sort_order, results::text AS results, lifecycle::text AS lifecycle, created_at, updated_at FROM public.skill_effects WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND effect_key = #{effectKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.skill_effects SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, results = CAST(#{results} AS jsonb), lifecycle = CAST(#{lifecycle,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND effect_key = #{effectKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.skill_effects WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey} AND effect_key = #{effectKey}
DELETE FROM public.skill_effects WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{skillKey}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public.skill_effects e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.results) r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(r #> '{detail,affectedSkillScope,skillKeys}') target(skill_key) WHERE e.game_id = #{gameId} AND e.skill_key <> #{skillKey} AND target.skill_key = #{skillKey}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public.skill_processes p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.effect_bindings) binding WHERE p.game_id = #{gameId} AND p.skill_key = #{skillKey} AND binding ->> 'effectKey' = #{effectKey}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public.skill_effects e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.results) r WHERE e.game_id = #{gameId} AND e.skill_key = #{skillKey} AND r ->> 'resultType' = 'LIFECYCLE_OPERATION' AND r #>> '{detail,targetEffectKey}' = #{targetEffectKey} AND r #>> '{detail,operation}' = 'REFRESH'
